_meta.rule: All pressures in kN/m2, angles in degrees, elevations in m (positive upward)

convention.Front: LEFT side — Active earth pressure (Ka), includes fill (dat dap)
convention.Back: RIGHT side — Passive earth pressure (Kp), no fill
convention.net_pressure: Net = Active(Front) - Passive(Back); positive = active dominates (danger zone)

bar_direction.Front_active: bars go LEFT (same as GeoData Front side)
bar_direction.Back_passive: bars go RIGHT (same as GeoData Back side)
bar_direction.Net_positive: bars go RIGHT (net loading pushes pile toward Back)
bar_direction.Net_negative: bars go LEFT (passive dominates, pile stable)

arrows.note: scale_units=xy scale=1 angles=xy — arrow length equals pressure in data units

active_pressure.sigma_v: accumulated vertical effective stress from top_elev downward
active_pressure.fill_contribution: fill layer (soil_level_front to top_elev) counted in sigma_v with gamma_fill
active_pressure.ka_rankine: Ka = tan2(45 - phi/2)  — vertical wall, delta=0, beta=0
active_pressure.ka_coulomb: Ka from Eq.25 TCVN 11823-3 — includes wall friction delta and slope beta
active_pressure.surcharge: delta_sigma_h = Ka * qs (uniform surcharge at pile top)

passive_pressure.sigma_v: accumulated vertical effective stress from soil_level_back downward
passive_pressure.note: Kp Coulomb underestimates for high phi — use Rankine as default

net_pressure.positive: Active > Passive — dangerous zone, pile may fail toward Back
net_pressure.resultant_Net: F_net = integral(Net * dz) [kN/m]; positive = net active load on pile

fill_layer.location: Front side only, from soil_level_front to top_elev
fill_layer.gamma_sub_auto: gamma_fill - 10.0  (when fill is below water table)

py_model_sign_convention.note: Sign convention for set_pointload(Py=F) in openpile p-y model
py_model_sign_convention.Py_positive: Force toward Front (excavation) = active earth direction

earth_net_h.reason: net_h > 0 means active dominates → pushes pile toward Front → Py positive

water_p_net.reason: p_net > 0 means Back > Front → pushes pile toward Front → same as active → Py positive

boussinesq_net.reason: bq_net > 0 means Front strip dominates → pushes pile toward Back → opposite of active → Py negative

visualization_arrows.direction: FROM soil boundary TOWARD wall face (x=0)

_meta.rule: All pressures in kN/m2, angles in degrees, elevations in m (positive upward)
